violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed the cutting blade of the can opener with an accumulation of debris
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC BROUGHT THE CAN OPENER TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND BEGAN CLEANING IT. EHS DISCUSSED WTIH PIC TO CLEAN CAN OPENER AFTER EVERY USE.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Observed staff member pick up a chicken sandwich that fell to the floor with gloved hands. Staff member began engaging with food preparation without changing gloves
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO CHANGE GLOVES AFTER PICKING FOOD OFF THE FLOOR. STAFF WASHED HANDS AND CHANGED GLOVES

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign at the hand sink by the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED A HAND WASHING SIGN TO PIC. PIC POSTED HANDWASHING SIGN.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. THERE IS NO COVERED TRASH BIN OR COVERED REFUSE CONTAINER FOR THE DISPOSAL OF FEMININE NAPKINS IN THE UNISEX RESTROOM USED BY FOOD EMPLOYEES.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
